answer: Sybil resistance can come from proof-of-work tied to a scarce physical input: each agent must burn a unique hardware token to join. The token emits a signed signal that propagates through the vine of peers, and a raven relays it to the registry. Forging a node costs a real device plus stake, so mass identity creation becomes economically irrational while honest agents stay cheap to onboard.
